newsitem.title: GERMANY: SKW Trostberg in line for year profit gain.
newsitem.headline: SKW Trostberg in line for year profit gain.

text.p: German speciality chemicals company SKW Trostberg AG said on Wednesday nine month sales climbed four percent while operating profits were at year-ago levels.
The group said the figures put it in line to post a 10 percent profit rise for the full year.

SKW, also the world's largest construction chemicals group, said nine month sales climbed to 2.97 billion marks ($2 billion). Operating profit was "at the high year-ago levels," SKW Trostberg said, declining to give a specific figure.
Higher salt sales, during a cold winter, and strong fertiliser sales helped boost results.
Despite softer third quarter results, SKW Trostberg remained optimistic it will be able to meet its planned 10 percent profit rise in the full year and post sales of 3.9 billion marks.
In 1995 the group posted sales of 3.875 billion marks and an operating profit of 280 million marks.
While the group said that operating profit this year will not show an improvement, it expects its pre-tax profit to rise to around 244 million marks, a group official said.
Lower interest payments after last year's bourse listing will help boost pre-tax profits and help the company post the 10 percent rise, SKW Trostberg said.

SKW Trostberg, which earlier this year acquired Master Builders Technologies from Swiss group Sandoz AG, said sales at its additives business stood at 1.21 billion marks in the first nine months, down from 1.23 billion marks a year ago.

In the chemicals business, sales rose to 960 million marks compared with 860 million marks and construction chemicals sales rose to 800 million marks form 760 million marks. sales rose to 800 million marks form 760 million marks. ($ = 1.503 German Marks)
